links.outcome: MedQA-USMLE majority-vote accuracy with versus without retrieved passages inserted into the prompt
links.effect: RAG over MedMCQA explanations gave no statistically significant gain in either model; in MedGemma the point estimate was -1.9 pp (p = 0.16).
links.quote: RAG over MedMCQA explanations does not produce a statistically significant gain in either model, and in the domain-tuned model the point estimate is slightly negative (-1.9 pp, p = 0.16).

unlisted_practices: Choosing a domain-fine-tuned small model over a general-purpose model of the same size (+6.8 pp majority-vote accuracy on MedQA)

screen.practice: retrieval grounding added to existing model
screen.reason: Evaluates the addition of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG grounding) vs. domain fine-tuning across models on a medical QA benchmark (MedQA-USMLE).
